content.title: Financing Just Energy Transition

content.text: This module addresses the financial and market strategies necessary to drive the global energy transition, with a particular focus on developing countries. It explores the critical roles of public and private sector investments, <ai prompt="What is innovative financing?">innovative financing 💬️</ai> mechanisms, and the dynamics of energy markets. The module highlights the barriers to scaling renewable energy financing, including regulatory challenges, market risks, and economic disparities, and offers practical strategies like blended finance models, de-risking instruments, and policy reforms to overcome them. However, the impacts of energy finance goes beyond just financial and market strategies and also involves the development impacts of energy investments including gender, social, financial, governance, climate and environmental aspects. The module also underscores the importance of inclusivity and sustainability by integrating gender, considerations and addressing systemic inequities in energy access.

objectives.title: Learn to analyze and understand global trends in energy investments, financial mechanism, and ESG integration that shape sustainable energy finance and drive the clean energy transition.
Evaluate how public and private investments, policy frameworks, and blended finance instruments can be leveraged to scale renewable energy solutions.
Explore innovative financial tools, digital technologies, and inclusive approaches that promote equitable, effective, and locally grounded development.
